existing_constructor_definition.meaning: The separately retained exception scopes of two connected actions; return and destruction exceptions are not flattened.
existing_constructor_definition.name: acquired_joint_exception_scope_v3

finding: The declared joint exception type separately retains the two connected action scopes. Actual return is no_acquired_exception; destruction is written_authorization with the unchanged original source quote. The earlier recognizer only supported authorized_action_alternative, so its remaining flag was validation coverage, not a surviving source omission.

issue.reason: Actual acquired plain return/destroy alternative omits written authorization required only for destruction. Native disposal label does not test this distinction.
